svg.title: where max(0, k + l−s) ≤q ≤min(k, l). Consequently every block basis entry BK ab is an integer times the single rational square root shown. The standard-library implementation expands the polynomial exactly with integer coefficients and encloses its normalization with directed rational square-root bounds. Blocks have size at most n + 1; the number of coefficient variables grows quadratically. For a given comparison ensemble, write gab = Tr(∆nBab). The relaxed correlation optimum has primal form sup y a+b odd gabyab, −1 2I ⪯ ∑︂ ab yabBK ab ⪯1 2I for all K.
